title: API Rate Limits and Quotas
content: Orbit Labs APIs enforce these limits: public API keys allow 1,000 requests per minute, internal service-to-service calls allow 5,000 requests per minute, and search endpoints allow 100 requests per minute. When a limit is exceeded the API returns HTTP 429 with a Retry-After header. Retry with exponential backoff and jitter.

title: How to Reset Your Password
content: Open the single sign-on page and choose 'Forgot password'. Enter your work email and follow the link sent to you. You must complete multi-factor authentication to finish the reset. If you do not receive the email within 10 minutes, post in the it-help channel. Passwords expire every 180 days.

title: How Do I Request Access to a Tool?
content: Access requests are submitted by your manager in the access portal. Choose the application, describe why you need it, and name the team space or project. Most requests are approved within 1 business day. Production access is read-only by default and write access expires after 2 hours.

title: VPN Access and Setup
content: The VPN client is installed on every company laptop. Sign in with your single sign-on account and approve the multi-factor prompt. Choose the 'Engineering' profile to reach internal services. If the connection drops repeatedly, restart the client and check that your laptop clock is correct.

title: When Are Production Releases?
content: Production releases happen on Tuesday and Thursday at 10:00 UTC. There is a change freeze on Fridays and on the day before public holidays. Hotfixes can be released at any time with approval from the on-call lead.

title: Which AI Models Can I Use?
content: Use local models through Ollama whenever possible. Mistral Nemo 12B is recommended for quality. Llama 3.2 3B and Phi-3 Mini are good choices for laptops with limited memory. Use the nomic-embed-text model for embeddings. Never paste personal data or credentials into an external AI service.
